The '''Arkanian dragon''' was a winged, [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the tundra [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] in the [[Perave system]].

==Description==
Native to the frozen tundra of the [[Perave system]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]], Arkanian dragons had two broad, jointed [[Limb/Legends|wings]], long necks and tails, and two legs terminating in three-toed feet. The dragons were of sufficient intelligence to be deemed [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]],<ref name="TEGTPAM" /> possessing a limited degree of reasoning ability.<ref name="TEGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

==History==
The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]], of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] also native to the dragon's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], crafted a training technique modeled on the dragon's fast-striking attacks, dubbed "the lightning strike of the Arkanian dragon," which he employed in the instruction of his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]], the brothers [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic]] and [[Cay Qel-Droma]] and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tott Doneeta]] at his [[Arca Jeth's praxeum|training center]] on Arkania.<ref name="TEGTPAM" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> a young and energetic Arkanian dragon was present in the throne room of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], kept leashed by an Arkanian individual.<ref name="BFANT">''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''</ref> The dragon's name was also borne by the ''[[Arkanian Dragon]]'', a [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFtS">{{DoD|The First to Strike}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Arkanian dragon was first mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|fifth issue]] of the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']],<ref name="DLotS">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref> written by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]], and published on [[February 14]]th, [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54575/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_5|text=Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi - Dark Lords Of The Sith (1994) #5}}</ref> They were depicted visually by artist [[Scott Kolins]] and eleborated upon by author [[Daniel Wallace]] in the [[1998]] [[Del Rey]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'',<ref name="TEGTPAM" /> and made their first narrative appearance in [[Elizabeth Hand]]'s [[2004]] [[Scholastic]] young readers' novel ''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]''.<ref name="BFANT" /> The Arkanian dragon was incorporated in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] by [[Timothy Zahn]] in the [[2017]] Del Rey novel [[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']].<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref>
